description: Foldergram (CT 144 foldergram-c, 10.0.36.37) AI telemetry. The app speaks OpenTelemetry only: it pushes to the Collector on the same host (otelcol.service), the Collector re-exports the metrics as Prometheus on :8889 and alloy scrapes that into Mimir. App side: docs/telemetry.md in the foldergram repo. The panels answer: is the queue draining, what does it cost, where does the time go and why does it stop.

panels.title: The plan - the limit that applies
The room there is
panels.description: How much faster the plan could be spent before its window runs out before it renews. Above 1 there is room to spare.

panels.title: Videos at a time
panels.description: How many videos the queue analyses at the same time. It follows the room the plan leaves.

panels.title: What is left of the plan
panels.description: The plan's own number, read from the provider. It is the limit the queue obeys.

panels.title: How long it lasts at this rate
panels.description: What is left of each window divided by how fast it is being spent. Null while the plan is not being spent.

panels.title: Is somebody else in the plan
panels.description: The plan is shared: the pool moved while nothing of ours was being sent. The queue yields half while that is so.

options.content:
The **plan is the limit**, not the token budget in the settings.

- The provider publishes how much of each window is left; the queue stops when a window has no room and carries on when it rolls over.
- *Lasts* is what is left divided by how fast it is going: the answer to "when does this run out".
- *Room* is how much faster the plan could be spent without running out before its window renews. Above 1 the queue works harder; below 1 it would exhaust the plan early and idle until the window rolls over.
- *Videos at a time* is the queue following that room.
- *Shared* means somebody else is in the plan: the queue takes only its share while that is so.

options.content: The token counters only move when an analysis **completes**. While the queue is paused by `upstream_quota` the request never reaches the model, so nothing is spent and there is no series to show. A non-empty panel here means the queue is running.

options.content: `frames` extracts the keyframes, `audio` extracts the sound, `transcribe` writes the text, `llm` asks the model. The samples count how many times each stage ran; the p95 below says how long it took. A stage with 0 samples means the pipeline stopped before reaching it.
